title: This is Extremely Dangerous to Our Democracy
summary: A short supercut showing many Sinclair-owned local news anchors reading the same scripted warning about biased news, word for word.
why: HN cites it as a vivid example of coordinated messaging and media consolidation, though some mentions use the title only as a quip.

quote.text: Only takes me one minute and thirty six seconds to convince anyone I meet of this point
